title: The strategy behind the work.
intro: Work in consumer insight, category positioning, product communication, launch planning, and marketing operations.
publication_policy: Professional summaries only. Exclude internal source records, business data, research findings, working documents, and report links.

cases.title: Consumer insight & brand direction
cases.summary: Using consumer research to inform category positioning, audience frameworks, and communication priorities.
cases.challenge: Connect consumer understanding with product and category communication.
cases.role: Worked on research interpretation, audience frameworks, category positioning, and communication direction within the Ardiles brand team.

modules.title: Consumer research
modules.text: Reviewed consumer research and translated relevant themes into marketing considerations.

modules.title: Category positioning
modules.text: Worked on category roles, audience frameworks, and communication principles for Running and Basketball.

modules.title: Questionnaire development
modules.text: Developed and refined customer questions to support product and communication research.

cases.deliverable: Research summaries, audience frameworks, category positioning, communication principles, and questionnaire development.

cases.title: Product messaging & launch communications
cases.summary: Turning product information into clear messages for consumers, retailers, media, and launch events.
cases.challenge: Connect product roles, technical information, and intended use with clear marketing communication.
cases.role: Worked on product copy, launch narratives, creative briefs, retailer communication, and media and event materials.

modules.title: Product roles & messaging
modules.text: Worked on use-case descriptions and product differentiation to support campaign communication.

modules.title: Product copy

modules.title: Launch narratives & creative briefs
modules.text: Prepared narrative direction, creative briefs, presentation materials, and media and event copy.

modules.title: Retail communication
modules.text: Prepared product communication and experience concepts for retail audiences.

cases.deliverable: Product messaging, copy revisions, creative briefs, launch narratives, presentation materials, and retailer, media, and event communication.

cases.title: Budgets, sponsorships & partner programs
cases.summary: Coordinating marketing resources, partner responsibilities, and reporting across campaigns.
cases.challenge: Give marketing activity clear priorities, responsibilities, and a structure for review.
cases.role: Worked on budget planning, sponsorship evaluation, market and audience analysis, partner-program materials, and campaign reporting.

modules.title: Budget planning & review
modules.text: Supported marketing budget planning, spending review, and reporting across campaigns.

modules.title: Market & audience analysis
modules.text: Prepared analysis to support marketing discussions and planning.

modules.title: Sponsorship evaluation

modules.title: Partner-program coordination
modules.text: Prepared partner briefs, content plans, and program materials to support coordination and delivery.

connections.title: Research, product marketing & operations
connections.text: Consumer research, category positioning, product messaging, and operating frameworks form part of the strategic work behind these campaigns.

connections.title: Launch planning & communication
connections.text: The wider campaign work included phased communication, creator briefs, PR drafts, educational content, and event-documentation requirements.

connections.title: Product-role thinking
connections.text: The creative direction prioritised walking and everyday use, with easy running as a secondary context. Product-role work separated the intended use case from shared technology names.

connections.title: Runergize Showdown: retail-partner marketing
connections.text: The campaign included planning for a partner-store content challenge and related communication.

connections.title: Event-to-content planning
connections.text: A participant-content playbook planned experience posts, interviews, follow-up reviews, deliverables, and asset reuse alongside the event communication.
